title: Broken
description: A resource pack that increases difficulty by distorting textures and fonts.
body:
This resource pack breaks fonts and distorts textures to increase difficulty.

The textures are distorted to the point where the GUI is invisible and the fonts are all broken into square shapes.

⚠️ **How to use (Important!):**

Since the GUI is invisible, once you apply the pack:  
Enter a world or server.  
Apply the pack.  
Press ESC three times to exit the invisible menu and return to the game.  
Enjoy the broken reality.

**When should you use it?**  
If you're tired of the vanilla Minecraft experience or want a unique experience for content creation.
